//: TEMPLATE — copy to <your-project>/.claude/settings.local.json and fill in.
This file is GITIGNORED in a real project because it holds secrets.
Run /tlm-project-setup instead of editing this by hand — it asks only the questions your
project actually needs, verifies each MCP with a real call, and writes this file for you.
ONBOARDING A TEAMMATE? Don't send them this file. Send an INIT DOC (./tlm-init.template.json,
or generate one with `init.mjs template --from-current`): it is the same shape minus your
secrets and per-machine paths, and /tlm-project-setup applies it instead of asking the questions.
context7 + framelink-figma MCP servers ship WITH the plugin (bundled in plugin.json) — do NOT
redefine them here. This file only holds the Figma token (env), OAuth-connector notes, and tlm.
//mcpServers: context7 and framelink-figma are bundled by the plugin and load automatically — nothing to add.
The bundled Framelink server reads FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN from the env block below.
Add an mcpServers block here ONLY for a project-specific server the plugin does not bundle.
//mcpConnectors: ClickUp and Slack are OAuth connectors, not stdio servers — they do NOT appear above.
Connect them at claude.ai → Settings → Connectors, then verify with /mcp in Claude Code.
Linear:  claude mcp add --transport sse linear https://mcp.linear.app/sse
GitHub Issues: no MCP — just `gh auth login`.

env.//: SECRETS. Never commit. Never echo back to the user.
env.//CONTEXT7_API_KEY: OPTIONAL — context7 works without it. A key raises rate limits. Get one at https://context7.com/dashboard (ctx7sk-...). The bundled context7 server reads it via --api-key=${CONTEXT7_API_KEY:-}. Delete this line if you have no key.

//ecosystem: THE OTHER REPOS OF THIS SYSTEM — the ones Claude may READ while working here: the backend an app
calls, a shared package, the web twin of a mobile flow. They are read-only reference; Claude opens
files in them and never edits or commits there. Listed PER PROJECT, so an unrelated repo never gets
pulled into context. A repo given as a git URL is cloned into workspaceRoot; one given as a folder
path stays where it is. /tlm-project-setup manages this via skills/tlm-project-setup/ecosystem.mjs
(add <path-or-giturl> | sync | index) and writes the map at indexFile.
Leave enabled:false for a standalone repo.

repos.name: tlm-api
repos.notes: REST API this app calls; endpoint shapes live in src/modules/**/dto

repos.name: tlm-web
repos.notes: web twin of these screens — reuse its Zod schemas and status vocabulary

//pluginRepo: THIS PROJECT'S LIVE RULES COPY. /tlm-project-setup installs the plugin's skills/ ai/ hooks/ setup/ into

effect immediately in this repo. The installed plugin under ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} stays the delivery
channel and the fallback; it is never edited in place (a marketplace update overwrites it).
